shots.note: Wide cafeteria lunch line (classroom set reused as cafeteria); hero in blue hoodie mid-line, Sam beside him; no number visible yet; trays, steam, lunch crowd
Close-up: Mrs. Park the cashier at the till; a soft white $40 pill appears nearly touching her head; hero stares, face swaps neutral to shock

shots.line: $40. It floats there, soft and white, like a price tag in the air.
shots.note: Macro insert: the $40 pill HUGE, soft white, floating like a price tag; blurred cafeteria behind

shots.line: Nobody else looks up, nobody else can see it. You
shots.note: Medium: hero glances around the lunch line; nobody else looks up; Mrs. Park's $40 pill visible only to him; crowd faces blank
Close-up: hero blinks, eyes shut then open; the $40 pill is still there above Mrs. Park; his face shifts to disbelief

shots.line: Park hands you your tray and takes your lunch money. Her number
shots.note: Medium: Mrs. Park hands hero his tray and takes his lunch money; her $40 pill above her head; Sam behind hero in line
Close-up: Mrs. Park's pill ticks $40 to $44 to $48, flashing green on each +$4 step; coins and tray on the counter

shots.note: Medium: hero watches the till, eyes wide; the $48 pill glows green above Mrs. Park; Sam nudges him
